'''Red Thirty''' was a callsign used by a starfighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in a [[Red Squadron (Star Tours)|Red Squadron]] operating a few months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The pilot was involved when the unit helped defend a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency [[StarSpeeder 3000]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] when the civilian vessel accidentally ended up in the midst of Red Squadron's [[Battle of Death Star III|battle]] to destroy a [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]&ndash;like space station.<ref name="ST" />
